meta.title: {brand} · Help nearby, between people
meta.description: Ask for or offer help with errands, paperwork, tech, home, pets, lessons and much more. In-app chat, protected payments and reviews from real services.

home.heroTitle: Trusted help, just around the corner
home.heroSubtitle: Find someone nearby for an errand, some paperwork, assembling furniture or learning to use your phone. Or put your time at the service of someone who needs it.
home.searchWhatPlaceholder: e.g. walk the dog, set up Wi-Fi…
home.trust: In-app chat, protected payments and reviews only from services booked here.
home.askText: Say what you need and get messages from people nearby who are happy to help.
home.askStep1: Post your request in two minutes
home.offerText: Share what you’re good at, choose when and where, and get paid safely.
home.offerStep1: Create a listing for your service
home.offerStep2: Reply to people who message you
home.offerStep3: Get paid once the service is done
home.useCaseAppointment: Accompany someone to a medical appointment
home.how1Text: Explain what you need or what you offer.
home.how2Text: Ask questions in the in-app chat without sharing your phone number.
home.how3Text: Receive a clear proposal with price, date and conditions.
home.how4Text: You pay on the platform; the money doesn’t reach the other person until the service is done.
home.how5Text: When everything is fine, you confirm the service was completed.
home.how6Text: Both people review each other and help the community choose better.
home.safety1Text: You pay through the platform and can open a claim if something goes wrong.
home.safety2Text: People who get paid go through identity verification. We explain what each badge means.
home.safety3Text: Only people who took part in a service booked here can leave a review.
home.safety4Text: A team reviews claims and is there when you need it.
home.safety5Text: You can report any listing, message or profile in two taps.
home.safety6Text: We only show the town or an approximate distance, never your address.
home.ctaText: Creating an account is free and you only pay when you book a service.

pages.howIntro: {brand} connects people who need a hand with people nearby who can give one. Here’s how it works, step by step.
pages.howOffer1: Create your account and complete your profile.
pages.howOffer2: Post a listing with what you can do, your area and your price.
pages.howOffer3: Set up payouts and verify your identity with our payment provider.
pages.howOffer4: Reply in the chat and send clear proposals.
pages.howOffer5: Provide the service and get paid once it’s confirmed.
pages.howPaymentsText: You pay through the platform when booking. The money is transferred to the person providing the service when you confirm it’s finished, or automatically after the deadline if you don’t open a claim. You always see the full breakdown before paying.
pages.safetyIntro: We want asking for and offering help to feel as safe as asking a trusted neighbour.
pages.safetyTip4: Be wary of anyone asking you to pay upfront outside the platform.
pages.safetyTip5: For dealings with public bodies, always use official representation. Nobody may use your keys.
pages.safetyTip6: If something looks wrong, report it: we review it and explain our decision.
pages.emergency: If there is immediate danger, call 112.
